openTuiStartup.description: Linux x64 OpenTUI startup gate for lando --version, covering end-to-end startup and time to first output at p95.

landofileLoad.description: Warm in-process loadLandofileLayers on the pre-decode-once integration base; tracing disabled, three warmups, median and nearest-rank p95 in milliseconds.

toolingHotPath.description: Linux x64 hot-path benchmark gate for lando <tooling-alias>. The target is 150 ms warm p95; the tracked 900 ms current baseline documents the present compiled-binary host-tooling warm path and must be reviewed when changed.
